title: SWF: DefineBitsLossless2 and JPEG3 tag encoding
description: Unit tests for bitmap tag encoding in packages/swf. Import encodeDefineBitsLossless2 and encodeDefineBitsJPEG3 from packages/swf/src/bitmap.ts. Test: encodeDefineBitsLossless2 produces a tag starting with correct type byte (36), has correct width/height in header, pixel data is zlib-compressed. encodeDefineBitsJPEG3 produces type 35 tag. Tests in packages/swf/src/__tests__/bitmap.test.ts.
